work.title: Foil Cross
work.description: Horizontal mixed-media assemblage incorporating reflective mylar sheeting, a cross-shaped foil structure mounted at upper center, and thirteen gold compact discs distributed across the composition. Red vertical ribbon strips descend against the mirrored ground; a computer keyboard lies detached to the left on a white surface, with printed labels and white cord elements visible throughout.
work.composition: central cross on horizontal foil ground
